scenario: 面试官给一个非结构化输入(文本/图片)的系统，问你怎么选神经网络架构，别只报模型名。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a system with unstructured input (text/image) and asks how you pick a neural architecture, not just name models.
q: 选架构该按什么顺序推理？
q_en: In what order should you reason to pick an architecture?
why: 先看输入模态(文本/图片/多模态)缩小家族，再看任务类型(检索用 embedding 还是逐词生成)定形态，最后用服务约束(延迟/吞吐/端上还是服务器 GPU)拍板。三步顺序保证你是被约束推着选，而不是凭偏好报模型名。
why_en: Go input modality, then task type, then serving constraint, so the requirements drive the choice instead of naming a favorite model.
diagram:
flowchart TD A["1. 输入模态
文本/图片/多模态"] --> B["2. 任务类型
检索 embedding vs 逐词生成"] B --> C["3. 服务约束
延迟/吞吐/端上 or 服务器 GPU"] C --> D["落地到具体架构"]
options: 先按团队最熟的模型选，再倒推它能不能满足延迟，能就用、不能再换一个
先看输入模态缩小家族，再看任务类型定形态，最后用服务约束(延迟/吞吐/端上)拍板
先定训练用什么 GPU 集群和框架，架构等训练管线搭好了再套一个进去
先挑准确率榜单第一名的模型，服务侧的延迟和内存问题上线后再优化
options_en: Pick the model the team knows best, then check if it meets latency; if not, swap for another.
Narrow the family by input modality, fix the form by task type, then decide with serving constraints (latency/throughput/edge).
First choose the training GPU cluster and framework, then fit an architecture into the pipeline once it is built.
Pick whatever tops the accuracy leaderboard and optimize latency and memory after launch.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务和延迟预算都还没定死(纯研究探索期)，可以先拿熟悉的 baseline 跑通再谈选型。
optionExplanations: 凭熟悉度选是把结论前置，很可能选中一个模态或延迟根本不匹配的模型，绕一大圈才发现。
对；模态先砍掉不相关家族、任务定 encoder/decoder 形态、服务约束做最终裁决，是被需求推着走。
GPU 和框架是实现细节，先定它等于先造车间再想造什么车，架构反而受工具牵制。
榜单第一往往参数多、延迟高，忽略服务约束选它，上线才发现端上或实时路径扛不住。
optionExplanations_en: Choosing by familiarity puts the conclusion first and often lands on a model whose modality or latency simply doesn't fit.
Correct — modality cuts irrelevant families, task fixes the encoder/decoder form, and serving constraints make the final call.
GPUs and frameworks are implementation details; fixing them first lets tooling dictate the architecture.
The leaderboard leader is usually param-heavy and high-latency, so ignoring serving constraints breaks edge or real-time paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入数据的类型：纯文本、纯图片还是文本+图片的多模态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Input modality is the kind of data fed in: text only, image only, or multimodal text-plus-image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上线后的运行限制：延迟预算、吞吐、跑在端上还是服务器 GPU。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A serving constraint is a runtime limit such as latency budget, throughput, and whether it runs on-device or on a server GPU.

scenario: 把输入序列长度从 512 翻到 1024 后，transformer 的注意力计算成本暴涨。
scenario_en: Doubling the transformer input sequence from 512 to 1024 makes attention compute blow up.
q: 自注意力对序列长度的复杂度是多少，翻倍长度会怎样？
q_en: What is self-attention's complexity in sequence length, and what happens when you double it?
why: 自注意力要算每个 token 对其他所有 token 的相关性，是 O(n²)：序列长度翻倍，计算和显存约变 4 倍。所以它直接约束你能设多长的最大输入、怎么组 batch、要多少 GPU 显存。
why_en: Self-attention is O(n squared) because every token attends to every other, so doubling the sequence roughly quadruples compute and memory, capping max input length and batching.
options: O(n)，长度翻倍成本翻倍，所以最大输入长度基本不受注意力限制
O(n log n)，长度翻倍成本增加约一倍多，显存压力可忽略
O(n²)，长度翻倍成本约变 4 倍，直接约束最大输入长度、batch 和显存
O(1)，注意力成本与序列长度无关，只由模型参数量决定
options_en: O(n): doubling length doubles cost, so max input length is barely limited by attention.
O(n log n): doubling length raises cost a bit over 2x, and memory pressure is negligible.
O(n squared): doubling length roughly quadruples cost, directly capping max input length, batch, and memory.
O(1): attention cost is independent of sequence length and set only by parameter count.
optionExplanations: 低估了：注意力是全对全比较，不是线性扫一遍，长序列的显存爆炸正来自平方项。
n log n 是排序类复杂度，注意力没有分治结构，实际是每对 token 都要算一次。
对；平方复杂度是 transformer 长文本受限的根因，长序列要么截断要么上稀疏/线性注意力变体。
参数量决定的是单步算力，序列长度通过 O(n²) 的注意力矩阵独立地放大成本。
optionExplanations_en: Underestimate: attention is all-pairs, not a linear scan, and the memory blowup on long sequences comes from the squared term.
n log n is sorting-style complexity; attention has no divide-and-conquer, so every token pair is computed once.
Correct — quadratic cost is why transformers struggle with long text, forcing truncation or sparse/linear-attention variants.
Parameter count sets per-step compute; sequence length independently scales cost through the O(n squared) attention matrix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让序列里每个 token 关注其他所有 token 并加权聚合的机制，是 transformer 的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-attention lets every token in a sequence attend to and weight all others, the core of a transformer.

scenario: 搜索系统要做查询意图分类，延迟预算 <5ms，QPS 很高，query 短。
scenario_en: A search system classifies query intent under a sub-5ms latency budget, high QPS, with short queries.
q: 该选哪种 transformer 形态？
q_en: Which transformer form should you pick?
why: 选 encoder-only(BERT)加蒸馏：它双向编码、输出可当 embedding，短序列蒸馏后推理 <10ms，还能把 embedding 离线预算好缓存进特征库,把推理挪出实时路径。decoder 逐词生成慢、也不是分类该用的形态。
why_en: Pick encoder-only BERT with distillation because bidirectional embeddings are precomputable and fast for short classification, whereas a decoder generates token by token and is the wrong form.
options: decoder-only(GPT)，让它逐词生成意图标签文本，灵活且好扩展到新意图
encoder-decoder(T5)，把意图分类当 seq2seq 翻译任务来做，通用性最好
encoder-only(BERT)+蒸馏，双向 embedding 可离线预算+缓存，短序列 <10ms
直接上最大的通用 LLM，用 few-shot prompt 分类，省掉训练分类头的工作
options_en: Decoder-only (GPT): generate the intent label as text token by token, flexible for new intents.
Encoder-decoder (T5): treat intent classification as a seq2seq translation task for generality.
Encoder-only (BERT) with distillation: bidirectional embeddings are precomputable and cacheable, sub-10ms on short input.
Just use the largest general LLM with few-shot prompting to classify, skipping a trained head.
whenOtherWins: 如果意图是开放式、无法枚举成固定标签集(要生成自然语言解释)，那才需要 decoder-only 的生成能力。
optionExplanations: 逐词生成引入 autoregressive 延迟，对固定标签的分类是杀鸡用牛刀，5ms 预算下扛不住。
seq2seq 同时背上编码+自回归解码两份成本，分类这种单标签任务用它纯属浪费。
对；BERT 双向表示天生适合分类，蒸馏压小后满足 5ms，embedding 还能预算缓存进特征库。
大 LLM 单次推理就几十上百毫秒，QPS 高时成本和延迟都爆，分类任务不需要这么重。
optionExplanations_en: Token-by-token generation adds autoregressive latency; it's overkill for fixed-label classification and won't fit 5ms.
Seq2seq carries both encode and autoregressive-decode costs, wasteful for a single-label classification task.
Correct — BERT's bidirectional representation suits classification, distillation fits 5ms, and embeddings can be precomputed into a feature store.
A large LLM costs tens to hundreds of ms per call, blowing latency and cost at high QPS for a task that doesn't need it.

termDefinitions.meaning: encoder-only 模型，双向编码文本，擅长分类、语义相似、检索的 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is an encoder-only model whose bidirectional embeddings suit classification and retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用小学生模型模仿大教师模型，压小参数换更快推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a small student to mimic a large teacher, shrinking the model for faster inference.

scenario: 面试官要你区分三种 transformer 形态在服务(serving)侧的关键差异。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to distinguish the three transformer forms by their key serving-side property.
q: encoder-only / decoder-only / encoder-decoder 各自的服务特性是什么？
q_en: What is each of encoder-only / decoder-only / encoder-decoder's serving property?
why: encoder-only 的 embedding 可离线预算+缓存,推理挪出实时路径;decoder-only 逐词生成,受显存带宽瓶颈;encoder-decoder 两份成本叠加(编码+自回归解码)。形态决定成本结构,不是准确率高低。
why_en: Encoder-only embeddings are precomputable, decoder-only is memory-bandwidth-bound autoregressive generation, and encoder-decoder stacks both costs.

rows: 逐词生成,显存带宽瓶颈
编码+自回归解码双份成本

options: 三种形态服务成本基本一致,选哪个只看训练时的准确率,与延迟无关
encoder-only 可离线预算 embedding;decoder-only 逐词生成受显存带宽瓶颈;encoder-decoder 双份成本
encoder-only 最慢因为双向要跑两遍,decoder-only 最快因为只单向,encoder-decoder 居中
decoder-only 的 embedding 可离线缓存,encoder-only 必须实时逐词生成,两者角色刚好相反
options_en: All three have essentially equal serving cost; choose by training accuracy, unrelated to latency.
Encoder-only precomputes embeddings; decoder-only generates token by token, memory-bandwidth-bound; encoder-decoder pays both.
Encoder-only is slowest because bidirectional runs twice, decoder-only fastest because one-directional, encoder-decoder in between.
Decoder-only embeddings cache offline while encoder-only must generate token by token in real time — the roles are swapped.
optionExplanations: 服务成本差异巨大:预算 embedding 与逐词生成完全不同量级,忽略它会选错部署方案。
对;形态直接决定成本结构——预算缓存、显存带宽、还是两者叠加,这才是服务侧要说清的差异。
双向不等于跑两遍,encoder 一次前向就出全序列表示;真正慢的是 decoder 的逐词自回归。
角色说反了:能预算缓存 embedding 的是 encoder-only,逐词生成的是 decoder-only。
optionExplanations_en: Serving costs differ hugely: precomputed embeddings versus token-by-token generation are different orders of magnitude.
Correct — the form dictates the cost structure: precompute-and-cache, memory-bandwidth-bound, or both stacked.
Bidirectional isn't two passes; the encoder produces the full-sequence representation in one forward pass — the decoder's autoregression is the slow part.
The roles are reversed: encoder-only is the one that precomputes embeddings, and decoder-only does token-by-token generation.

termDefinitions.meaning: decoder-only 模型,自回归地一次生成一个 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a decoder-only model that autoregressively generates one token at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: encoder-decoder 模型,把各种 NLP 任务统一成文本到文本的 seq2seq。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) is an encoder-decoder model casting NLP tasks as text-to-text seq2seq.

termDefinitions.term: memory-bandwidth bottleneck / 显存带宽瓶颈
termDefinitions.meaning: 生成时反复从显存搬运权重,速度受带宽而非算力限制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A memory-bandwidth bottleneck is when generation is limited by moving weights from memory, not by compute.

scenario: 线上部署一个 GPT 类生成模型,发现模型越大吞吐掉得越狠,GPU 算力却没跑满。
scenario_en: Serving a GPT-style generator, throughput drops sharply as the model grows while GPU compute sits underused.
q: decoder-only 生成的主要服务失败模式是什么,怎么缓解?
q_en: What is the main serving failure mode of decoder-only generation, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 瓶颈在显存带宽:自回归每步都要把全部权重从显存搬到计算单元,模型增大的速度快过带宽增长,所以算力空转、带宽先到顶。缓解靠量化/蒸馏减小权重体积、KV cache 复用、批处理摊薄搬运成本。
why_en: Decoder generation is memory-bandwidth-bound because each step reloads all weights, so growing the model outpaces bandwidth; mitigate with quantization, KV cache, and batching.
options: 瓶颈是显存带宽:每步搬全部权重,模型增速快过带宽;靠量化/蒸馏/KV cache/批处理缓解
瓶颈是网络 I/O:生成慢因为每个 token 都要往数据库写一次,加缓存即可解决
瓶颈是 CPU 单线程:decoder 无法并行,换更多 CPU 核心就能线性提升吞吐
瓶颈是磁盘读取:模型每步从磁盘加载权重,换 SSD 就能消除延迟
options_en: It's memory bandwidth: each step moves all weights and the model outgrows bandwidth; mitigate with quantization/distillation/KV cache/batching.
It's network I/O: generation is slow because each token writes to a database, so adding a cache fixes it.
It's single-threaded CPU: the decoder can't parallelize, so more CPU cores scale throughput linearly.
It's disk reads: the model loads weights from disk each step, so switching to SSD removes the latency.
optionExplanations: 对;自回归的成本主要是权重搬运,不是算力,所以要压权重体积(量化/蒸馏)、复用 KV、批处理摊销。
生成慢与写数据库无关,token 是在 GPU 上算出来的,瓶颈在显存到计算单元的带宽。
推理跑在 GPU 上,不是 CPU 单线程问题;加 CPU 核心解决不了显存带宽限制。
权重推理时已在显存里,不是每步读磁盘;SSD 改善不了显存带宽这个真正的瓶颈。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — autoregressive cost is dominated by weight movement, so shrink weights (quantize/distill), reuse KV cache, and batch.
Slow generation isn't about database writes; tokens are computed on the GPU, and the bottleneck is memory-to-compute bandwidth.
Inference runs on the GPU, not single-threaded CPU; adding CPU cores can't relieve a memory-bandwidth limit.
Weights sit in GPU memory at inference, not read from disk each step; an SSD doesn't touch the real memory-bandwidth bottleneck.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存已生成 token 的注意力键值,避免每步重算历史,是生成加速的关键。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A KV (Key-Value) cache stores attention keys/values of past tokens so generation doesn't recompute history each step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次生成一个 token,把已生成的接回输入再预测下一个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Autoregressive generation emits one token at a time, feeding what's produced back in to predict the next.

scenario: 快速回忆三种 transformer 形态对应的代表模型和主用途。
scenario_en: Quickly recall the three transformer forms with their representative model and main use.
q: 补全三种 transformer 形态的代表与用途:
q_en: Fill in each transformer form's representative model and use:
text: 分类/embedding/检索用 {{encoder-only}}(BERT);逐词生成用 {{decoder-only}}(GPT);摘要/翻译等 seq2seq 用 {{encoder-decoder}}(T5)。
text_en: Classification/embedding/retrieval uses {{encoder-only}} (BERT); token-by-token generation uses {{decoder-only}} (GPT); summarization/translation seq2seq uses {{encoder-decoder}} (T5).
why: 记忆钩子:任务性质决定形态——要理解就 encoder,要生成就 decoder,要输入输出都是序列就 encoder-decoder。形态一定,服务成本结构随之确定。
why_en: Task shape fixes the form: understand with an encoder, generate with a decoder, sequence-to-sequence with encoder-decoder.

scenario: 面试里要给 NLP 架构标注量级锚点:BERT 短序列蒸馏后 <10ms,GPT 家族生成约 30–50 tokens/秒。
scenario_en: You annotate NLP latency anchors: distilled BERT under 10ms on short input, GPT-family generation about 30-50 tokens/sec.
q: 这两个延迟锚点对设计意味着什么?
q_en: What do these two latency anchors imply for design?
why: 这两个是经验量级(依模型/硬件而变),不是公式:BERT<10ms 说明分类/检索可放实时路径甚至预算缓存;GPT 30–50 tok/s 说明生成 200 token 要几秒,长输出必须靠流式返回、限长或加大批处理来遮蔽延迟。
why_en: These are empirical anchors: sub-10ms BERT can sit on the real-time path, while 30-50 tokens/sec means long generations take seconds and need streaming or length caps.
options: BERT<10ms 说明它比 GPT 更准,GPT 慢是因为准确率更低,所以永远优先选 BERT
两个数都是硬性 SLA,任何硬件上都必须精确达到,达不到就说明架构选错了
BERT<10ms 可放实时路径;GPT 30–50 tok/s 意味着长输出要几秒,需流式/限长/批处理遮蔽延迟
GPT 30–50 tok/s 说明它比 BERT 快很多,长文本生成可以放进 5ms 的实时预算里
options_en: Sub-10ms BERT means it's more accurate; GPT is slow because it's less accurate, so always prefer BERT.
Both numbers are hard SLAs that must be hit exactly on any hardware, or the architecture is wrong.
Sub-10ms BERT fits the real-time path; 30-50 tokens/sec means long outputs take seconds, needing streaming/length caps/batching.
GPT at 30-50 tokens/sec is much faster than BERT, so long-text generation fits inside a 5ms real-time budget.
optionExplanations: 延迟不代表准确率;两者形态不同、任务不同,不能拿速度当质量的证据。
这是随模型和硬件浮动的经验锚点,不是必须精确命中的合同 SLA。
对;把速度锚点翻译成设计动作——快的放实时、慢的靠流式和限长遮蔽,才是有信号的答法。
算反了:30–50 tok/s 是慢的一侧,生成几十个 token 就要上秒,塞不进 5ms。
optionExplanations_en: Latency isn't accuracy; different forms and tasks mean you can't use speed as evidence of quality.
These are empirical anchors that float with model and hardware, not contract SLAs to hit exactly.
Correct — translating speed anchors into design moves (fast on real-time, slow behind streaming/caps) is the high-signal answer.
Backwards: 30-50 tokens/sec is the slow side; generating dozens of tokens takes over a second, not 5ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成模型每秒吐出的 token 数,衡量自回归解码速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tokens per second is how many tokens a generator emits each second, measuring autoregressive decode speed.

scenario: 语义相似/检索系统用 BERT 出 embedding,担心每次查询都实时跑 BERT 会拖垮延迟。
scenario_en: A semantic-similarity/retrieval system uses BERT embeddings and worries that running BERT per query wrecks latency.
q: encoder-only 的哪个服务特性能把推理挪出实时路径?
q_en: Which encoder-only serving property moves inference off the real-time path?
why: BERT 的 embedding 对固定文档是稳定的,可以离线批量算好、缓存进特征库或 ANN 索引;线上只做向量查表/近邻检索,BERT 前向不在关键路径上。代价是新增/变更文档要重算并回填 embedding。
why_en: BERT embeddings for fixed items are stable, so precompute them offline into a feature store or ANN index and only look up at serving, keeping the forward pass off the hot path.
options: 把 BERT 换成更大的模型,准确率上去后就不用实时推理了
embedding 离线批量预算+缓存进特征库/ANN,线上只查表,BERT 前向不在实时路径
给每个查询开一个新 GPU 实时跑 BERT,靠水平扩容硬扛延迟
把 BERT 放在客户端浏览器里跑,服务器完全不参与 embedding 计算
options_en: Swap BERT for a bigger model; once accuracy is up you no longer need real-time inference.
Precompute embeddings offline into a feature store/ANN and just look them up at serving, keeping BERT's forward pass off the hot path.
Spin up a fresh GPU per query to run BERT live, brute-forcing latency by horizontal scaling.
Run BERT in the client browser so the server never computes embeddings at all.
optionExplanations: 换大模型只会更慢,和把推理挪出实时路径没关系,方向反了。
对;对固定文档 embedding 可复用,离线算好当特征查表,是把推理搬离关键路径的标准手法。
每查一次就实时跑 BERT 正是要避免的,水平扩容只是烧钱不改成本结构。
端上跑重模型受设备算力限制,且无法共享缓存,不是这里的服务特性。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger model is only slower and has nothing to do with moving inference off the hot path — wrong direction.
Correct — embeddings for fixed items are reusable, so precomputing them as lookup features is the standard way to leave the hot path.
Running BERT live per query is exactly what to avoid; horizontal scaling just burns money without changing the cost structure.
Running a heavy model on-device is capped by device compute and can't share a cache — not the serving property here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线算好、供线上低延迟查表的特征存储系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store holds precomputed features for low-latency online lookup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索,在向量库里快速找相似向量,牺牲一点精度换速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search quickly finds similar vectors, trading a little accuracy for speed.

scenario: 面试官让你在准确率-延迟-参数量三角上区分 CNN、ResNet、ViT。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to place CNN, ResNet, and ViT on the accuracy-latency-parameter triangle.
q: 三种视觉架构在三角上各占什么位置?
q_en: Where does each vision architecture sit on the triangle?
why: CNN(MobileNet/EfficientNet)参数省、最快、适合端上,但复杂任务准确率有天花板;ResNet 靠残差连接做深、准确率-延迟平衡,是服务器端特征提取默认骨干;ViT 大数据下 SOTA 但参数和算力最多、延迟高,需大规模预训练。
why_en: CNNs are param-light and fastest for edge with an accuracy ceiling, ResNet balances accuracy and latency as the server backbone, and ViT is SOTA on big data but heaviest and needs large pretraining.
options: 三者准确率、延迟、参数量都差不多,选哪个只看团队熟悉度
ViT 参数最少最快适合端上,MobileNet 参数最多适合服务器高准确率
CNN 省参最快适合端上;ResNet 平衡做服务器骨干;ViT 大数据 SOTA 但最重需预训练
ResNet 参数最多准确率最低,CNN 参数最少准确率最高,ViT 居中
options_en: All three are similar in accuracy, latency, and params; choose by team familiarity.
ViT is smallest and fastest for edge; MobileNet is biggest and suits high-accuracy servers.
CNNs are param-light and fastest for edge; ResNet balances as the server backbone; ViT is SOTA on big data but heaviest and needs pretraining.
ResNet has the most params and lowest accuracy, CNN the fewest params and highest accuracy, ViT in between.
optionExplanations: 三者差异恰恰在这三个维度上,说都差不多等于放弃了选型依据。
位置全反了:MobileNet 才是省参端上的,ViT 是参数最多的服务器侧模型。
对;三角三个角各有定位——端上省参、服务器平衡、大数据高准确率,选型就是在这上面权衡。
关系搞反了:CNN 参数最少但准确率有天花板,ViT 参数最多、准确率最高。
optionExplanations_en: The differences are exactly along those three axes; calling them similar throws away the basis for choosing.
The positions are reversed: MobileNet is the param-light edge model and ViT is the param-heaviest server model.
Correct — each corner has a niche: param-light edge, balanced server, big-data accuracy, and selection weighs among them.
The relationship is inverted: CNNs have the fewest params but an accuracy ceiling, while ViT has the most params and highest accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用卷积层利用图像空间局部性,参数高效,MobileNet/EfficientNet 属此类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) uses convolution to exploit spatial locality, parameter-efficient; MobileNet/EfficientNet belong here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用残差(跳跃)连接让网络加深到 50–152 层而不梯度消失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ResNet (Residual Network) uses residual skip connections to train 50-152 layers without vanishing gradients.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图片切成固定块当 token,用自注意力处理,大数据上准确率 SOTA。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ViT (Vision Transformer) splits an image into fixed patches as tokens and applies self-attention, SOTA on large data.

scenario: 手机 App 要在设备上做实时图像分类,延迟预算 <5ms,不能依赖服务器 GPU。
scenario_en: A mobile app needs on-device real-time image classification under a 5ms budget with no server GPU.
q: 该选哪种视觉架构?
q_en: Which vision architecture fits?
why: 选 MobileNet/EfficientNet:卷积利用空间局部性、参数少、专为端上 <5ms 预算设计,直接跑在手机 NPU/CPU 上。ViT 参数上百 M、延迟几十毫秒,端上装不下也跑不动;ResNet 更适合服务器侧。
why_en: Pick MobileNet/EfficientNet: param-light convolutions built for a sub-5ms on-device budget, whereas ViT's hundreds of millions of params won't fit or run on a phone.
options: ViT-Large,准确率最高,端上体验最好
ResNet-152,深层网络端上也能保证高准确率
先在服务器跑大模型再把结果推给手机,反正有网络
MobileNet/EfficientNet,参数省、专为端上 <5ms 设计,跑在手机 NPU/CPU
options_en: ViT-Large for the highest accuracy and best on-device experience.
ResNet-152, a deep network that still guarantees high accuracy on-device.
Run a big model on the server and push results to the phone since there's a network anyway.
MobileNet/EfficientNet: param-light, built for a sub-5ms on-device budget, running on the phone's NPU/CPU.
whenOtherWins: 如果设备端能稳定联网、延迟预算宽松、且准确率是硬指标,把重模型放服务器返回结果才更划算。
optionExplanations: ViT-Large 上百 M 参数、几十毫秒延迟,手机既装不下也跑不进 5ms。
ResNet-152 太深太重,端上延迟远超 5ms,是服务器批量场景才用的。
题目要求端上实时,依赖网络往返会引入不可控延迟且离线不可用,不符合约束。
对;MobileNet/EfficientNet 就是为端上省参低延迟设计的,能落在 5ms 预算内。
optionExplanations_en: ViT-Large's hundreds of millions of params and tens of ms won't fit on a phone or hit 5ms.
ResNet-152 is too deep and heavy; on-device latency far exceeds 5ms, and it's for server batch use.
The task demands on-device real-time; a network round-trip adds uncontrolled latency and breaks offline, violating the constraint.
Correct — MobileNet/EfficientNet are designed for param-light low-latency on-device inference within 5ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为移动/边缘设计的高效 CNN,参数少、延迟低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MobileNet/EfficientNet are efficient CNNs designed for mobile/edge with few params and low latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 手机上专门加速神经网络推理的处理单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An NPU (Neural Processing Unit) is on-device hardware that accelerates neural-network inference.

scenario: 服务器端图像任务准确率优先,但只有几万张有标注图片,预训练数据也有限。
scenario_en: A server-side image task prioritizes accuracy but has only tens of thousands of labeled images and limited pretraining data.
q: 该上 ViT 还是 ResNet?
q_en: Should you use ViT or ResNet here?
why: 选 ResNet + 迁移学习:ViT 缺少卷积的空间归纳偏置,必须靠大规模预训练数据才能超过 ResNet;标注数据有限时 ViT 容易欠拟合。ResNet 残差骨干在中小数据上更稳,准确率-延迟也平衡。
why_en: Pick ResNet with transfer learning: ViT lacks convolution's spatial inductive bias and needs large-scale pretraining to beat ResNet, so on limited data ResNet is more reliable.
options: ViT-Large,参数最多所以在任何数据量下都比 ResNet 准
ResNet + 迁移学习,数据有限时比缺归纳偏置的 ViT 更稳、更易达标
从零训练一个 ViT,虽然数据少但从头训能避免负迁移
MobileNet,反正准确率差不多还更快
options_en: ViT-Large — with the most params it beats ResNet at any data size.
ResNet with transfer learning — on limited data it's more reliable than a ViT that lacks inductive bias.
Train a ViT from scratch — with little data, training fresh avoids negative transfer.
MobileNet — accuracy is about the same and it's faster anyway.
whenOtherWins: 当有大规模预训练数据(或可用现成大预训练 ViT 权重)且延迟预算允许时,ViT 的准确率上限更高,值得上。
optionExplanations: 参数多不等于小数据上更准;ViT 缺归纳偏置,没有大预训练反而更容易过拟合/欠拟合。
对;ResNet 的卷积归纳偏置让它在中小数据上样本效率更高,迁移学习进一步省数据。
从零训 ViT 更吃数据,几万张远不够,大概率跑不过用预训练的 ResNet。
题目准确率优先,MobileNet 有准确率天花板,牺牲的正是这里最看重的指标。
optionExplanations_en: More params doesn't mean more accurate on small data; without big pretraining, ViT tends to overfit/underfit.
Correct — ResNet's convolutional inductive bias gives better sample efficiency on limited data, and transfer learning saves more.
Training ViT from scratch is even more data-hungry; tens of thousands of images won't beat a pretrained ResNet.
The task prioritizes accuracy, but MobileNet's accuracy ceiling sacrifices exactly the metric that matters here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型结构自带的先验假设,如 CNN 假设图像有空间局部性,减少所需数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inductive bias is a structural prior, like a CNN assuming spatial locality, which reduces the data needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拿在大数据上预训练好的模型作起点,在目标任务上微调,省数据省算力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transfer learning starts from a model pretrained on large data and fine-tunes it on the target task, saving data and compute.

scenario: 面试官问 ResNet 到底靠什么能训到 50–152 层这么深。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what lets ResNet train as deep as 50-152 layers.
q: ResNet 的残差连接解决了什么问题?
q_en: What problem do ResNet's residual connections solve?
why: 残差(跳跃)连接让每层学的是相对上一层的增量 F(x)+x,梯度能沿捷径直接回传,绕开深层网络的梯度消失,从而能堆到 50–152 层。ResNet-50 因此成为两阶段系统常用的特征提取骨干。
why_en: Residual skip connections let each layer learn an increment F(x)+x so gradients flow through the shortcut, avoiding vanishing gradients and enabling 50-152 layers.
options: 把注意力引入卷积,使模型能关注图像最重要的区域
自动搜索最优网络结构,省去人工设计层数
残差跳跃连接让梯度走捷径回传,绕开深层梯度消失,能堆到 50–152 层
把图像切成 patch 当 token,用 transformer 处理长程依赖
options_en: Introduces attention into convolution so the model focuses on the most important image regions.
Automatically searches the optimal architecture, removing manual layer-count design.
Residual skip connections route gradients through a shortcut, avoiding deep vanishing gradients and enabling 50-152 layers.
Splits the image into patch tokens and uses a transformer for long-range dependencies.
optionExplanations: 那是注意力机制(GAT/ViT)的思路,不是 ResNet 残差连接解决的问题。
自动搜结构是 NAS 的事,ResNet 的层数是人工设计的残差堆叠。
对;残差连接的核心就是给梯度一条捷径,让极深网络仍可训练。
patch+transformer 是 ViT 的做法,ResNet 是纯卷积+残差,不切 patch。
optionExplanations_en: That's the attention idea (GAT/ViT), not what ResNet's residual connections solve.
Auto-searching architectures is NAS; ResNet's depth is hand-designed residual stacking.
Correct — residual connections give gradients a shortcut so very deep networks stay trainable.
Patch-plus-transformer is ViT; ResNet is pure convolution with residuals and doesn't patch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深层网络反向传播时梯度逐层缩小趋近于零,前面的层学不动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Vanishing gradients occur when backprop shrinks gradients toward zero through many layers, stalling early-layer learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某层输入直接加到其输出上(F(x)+x),给梯度一条捷径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A residual connection adds a layer's input to its output (F(x)+x), giving gradients a shortcut.

scenario: 在 V100、batch=1 下:ResNet-50 约 25.6M 参数/4.1ms/76% top-1,ViT-Base 约 86M/11.4ms/85.5%。
scenario_en: On V100 batch=1: ResNet-50 is ~25.6M params/4.1ms/76% top-1, ViT-Base ~86M/11.4ms/85.5%.
q: 这组数字对选型意味着什么?
q_en: What does this set of numbers imply for selection?
why: 这些是基准量级(随硬件/优化浮动):ViT 用约 3.3 倍参数、约 2.8 倍延迟换来约 +9 个点 top-1。所以只有当准确率增益值这份延迟和显存、且有大预训练数据时才上 ViT;否则 ResNet-50 是准确率-延迟更划算的默认骨干。
why_en: These are benchmark anchors: ViT trades roughly 3x params and 2.8x latency for about +9 points top-1, so use it only when the accuracy gain is worth the latency and you have pretraining data.
options: ViT 参数是 ResNet 的 3 倍多、延迟约 2.8 倍,换约 +9 点准确率;值不值这份延迟才是选型问题
ViT 延迟更低所以更适合端上,ResNet 只能放服务器
两者准确率只差几个点,可以忽略,永远选参数更少的 ResNet
参数越多准确率越高是铁律,所以任何场景都该选 ViT-Base
options_en: ViT has 3x+ the params and ~2.8x latency for ~+9 points accuracy; whether that latency is worth it is the selection question.
ViT has lower latency so it suits edge; ResNet can only go on servers.
The two differ by only a few points, negligible, so always pick the param-lighter ResNet.
More params always means more accuracy, so pick ViT-Base in every scenario.
optionExplanations: 对;把数字翻译成"多花的延迟/显存换来的准确率增量值不值",这才是选型该回答的问题。
读反了:ViT-Base 11.4ms 比 ResNet 的 4.1ms 更慢,不是更适合端上。
9 个点在很多任务上是巨大差距,不能一概忽略,要看任务对准确率的敏感度。
参数多不必然更准且成本更高;是否值得要结合延迟预算和数据量判断,不是铁律。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — translating the numbers into 'is the accuracy gain worth the extra latency/memory' is the real selection question.
Backwards: ViT-Base at 11.4ms is slower than ResNet's 4.1ms, not better for edge.
About 9 points is a huge gap on many tasks; you can't dismiss it without checking accuracy sensitivity.
More params isn't always more accurate and costs more; worth-it depends on latency budget and data, not a law.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型最高概率的那个类别正好是正确类的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-1 accuracy is the fraction of cases where the model's highest-probability class is the correct one.

scenario: 面试官问 ViT 是怎么把 transformer 用到图像上的,以及它对数据的要求。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how ViT applies a transformer to images and what data it needs.
q: ViT 的输入处理方式和数据前提是什么?
q_en: How does ViT process input, and what is its data prerequisite?
why: ViT 把图片切成固定大小的 patch,每个 patch 线性投影成一个 token,再送自注意力,像处理词序列一样处理图像块。它缺卷积的空间归纳偏置,所以要大规模预训练数据才能超过 ResNet。
why_en: ViT splits the image into fixed-size patches, projects each into a token, and runs self-attention, but lacking convolution's inductive bias it needs large-scale pretraining to beat ResNet.
options: ViT 用卷积核滑窗提特征,和 CNN 一样,只是层数更深所以数据要求低
ViT 把图片切成固定 patch 当 token 做自注意力,缺归纳偏置需大规模预训练数据
ViT 逐像素自回归生成图像,数据越少越好训
ViT 用残差连接堆到几百层,靠深度而非注意力取胜,不需要预训练
options_en: ViT uses sliding convolution kernels like a CNN, just deeper, so it needs less data.
ViT splits the image into fixed patches as tokens for self-attention, and lacking inductive bias needs large-scale pretraining.
ViT autoregressively generates the image pixel by pixel and trains best with less data.
ViT stacks hundreds of layers with residual connections, winning by depth not attention, needing no pretraining.
optionExplanations: ViT 不用卷积滑窗,正因为丢了卷积的归纳偏置,它反而更吃数据,不是更省。
对;patch→token→自注意力是 ViT 的核心,而它的代价就是对大规模预训练数据的依赖。
ViT 是判别式编码器不是逐像素生成器,而且数据越少越难训,不是越好。
残差堆深是 ResNet;ViT 靠自注意力,而且恰恰需要大规模预训练。
optionExplanations_en: ViT doesn't use sliding convolutions; dropping that inductive bias makes it more data-hungry, not less.
Correct — patch to token to self-attention is ViT's core, and its cost is the dependence on large-scale pretraining.
ViT is a discriminative encoder, not a pixel-by-pixel generator, and less data makes it harder, not easier.
Residual-stacked depth is ResNet; ViT relies on self-attention and specifically needs large-scale pretraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图片切成的固定大小小方块,ViT 里每个 patch 投影成一个 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A patch is a fixed-size square the image is cut into; ViT projects each patch into a token.

scenario: 做两阶段目标检测,第一阶段要一个成熟、准确率-延迟平衡的特征提取骨干供后续检测头使用。
scenario_en: In two-stage object detection, stage one needs a mature, accuracy-latency-balanced feature-extraction backbone for the detection head.
q: 服务器端默认骨干选什么最稳妥?
q_en: What is the safest default server-side backbone?
why: 选 ResNet-50:约 25M 参数、约 4ms、约 76% top-1,准确率-延迟平衡且生态成熟,是两阶段检测最常用的特征提取骨干。MobileNet 准确率不够、ViT 又太重且吃预训练数据,做通用骨干不如 ResNet-50 稳。
why_en: Pick ResNet-50: ~25M params, ~4ms, ~76% top-1, a balanced and mature feature-extraction backbone widely used in two-stage detection.
options: MobileNetV3,最省参最快,做骨干准确率也够用
ViT-Large,准确率最高,当骨干后续检测头效果最好
ResNet-50,约 25M/4ms/76%,准确率-延迟平衡且生态成熟,两阶段检测常用骨干
每次请求都从零训练一个小网络当骨干,保证贴合当前数据
options_en: MobileNetV3 — smallest and fastest, and accurate enough as a backbone.
ViT-Large — highest accuracy, so the detection head works best on it.
ResNet-50 — ~25M/4ms/76%, balanced accuracy-latency and mature, the common two-stage detection backbone.
Train a fresh small network per request as the backbone to fit the current data.
whenOtherWins: 若目标平台是移动端、延迟极紧,骨干可换成 MobileNet/EfficientNet;若有大预训练数据且延迟宽松,可换 ViT 提准确率。
optionExplanations: MobileNet 准确率有天花板,做检测骨干时上限拉低整条管线的召回/精度。
ViT-Large 太重、吃预训练数据,做通用检测骨干成本和延迟都不划算。
对;ResNet-50 在准确率、延迟、生态成熟度上都平衡,是服务器骨干的安全默认。
每请求从零训练不现实,骨干要的是稳定可复用的预训练特征,不是即时训练。
optionExplanations_en: MobileNet's accuracy ceiling caps the whole pipeline's recall/precision when used as a detection backbone.
ViT-Large is heavy and pretraining-hungry, making it costly and slow as a general detection backbone.
Correct — ResNet-50 balances accuracy, latency, and ecosystem maturity, the safe default server backbone.
Training from scratch per request is impractical; a backbone needs stable reusable pretrained features, not on-the-fly training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统里负责把原始输入编码成特征、供下游头复用的基础网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A backbone is the base network that encodes raw input into features reused by downstream heads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先提区域候选再对候选分类/回归的目标检测范式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-stage detection first proposes regions, then classifies/regresses those candidates.

scenario: Pinterest 式视觉搜索:要用文字查图片、也支持以图搜图,还想做零样本分类,规模上亿。
scenario_en: Pinterest-style visual search: query images by text or by image, plus zero-shot classification, at hundreds of millions of items.
q: 跨模态检索/零样本该选哪个多模态架构?
q_en: For cross-modal retrieval / zero-shot, which multimodal architecture?
why: 选 CLIP:图像编码器和文本编码器经对比学习对齐到同一 embedding 空间,两侧 embedding 都能离线预算好、灌进 ANN 索引,线上只做 cosine 最近邻查表,服务模式≈双塔检索,天然适配已有 ANN 基建。Flamingo 无法拆成可预算的双塔。
why_en: Pick CLIP: contrastively aligned image and text encoders let you precompute both embeddings into an ANN index and serve cosine lookups, matching two-tower retrieval infra.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I["图片"] --> IE["图像编码器"] --> S["共享 embedding 空间"]
  T["文本"] --> TE["文本编码器"] --> S
  S --> A["ANN 索引 + cosine 查表"]
options: Flamingo,它能联合推理,顺便也能做检索,一套架构全包
CLIP,双编码器对比学习对齐共享空间,embedding 可离线预算+ANN 查表,≈双塔检索
T5,把"找相似图"当 seq2seq 生成任务来做
给每对(查询,图片)实时跑一个大模型算相似度,精度最高
options_en: Flamingo — it does joint reasoning and can also retrieve, one architecture for everything.
CLIP — dual encoders contrastively aligned in a shared space, embeddings precomputable into ANN lookups, like two-tower retrieval.
T5 — treat 'find similar images' as a seq2seq generation task.
Run a big model live on every (query, image) pair to score similarity for max precision.
whenOtherWins: 当任务不是检索而是需要对图文联合推理(看图回答问题、生成描述)时,才该上 Flamingo 而非 CLIP。
optionExplanations: Flamingo 每次请求都要跑完整管线、无法预算双塔,拿它做上亿规模检索延迟和成本都不合适。
对;CLIP 的对比对齐让两模态可比,embedding 离线算好走 ANN,正好复用已有的双塔检索基建。
T5 是文本 seq2seq,不产出可检索的跨模态向量,套不到以图搜图上。
对每对实时跑大模型是 O(N) 全量打分,上亿规模根本跑不动,ANN 查表才是正解。
optionExplanations_en: Flamingo runs the full pipeline per request with no precomputable towers, wrong on latency and cost at hundreds of millions.
Correct — CLIP's contrastive alignment makes the modalities comparable, embeddings precompute into ANN, reusing two-tower retrieval infra.
T5 is text seq2seq and doesn't produce searchable cross-modal vectors, so it can't do image-to-image search.
Scoring every pair live is O(N) full scan, impossible at hundreds of millions; ANN lookup is the answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用对比学习把图像编码器和文本编码器对齐到同一 embedding 空间的多模态模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) aligns an image encoder and a text encoder into one shared embedding space via contrastive learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询塔和物品塔各自编码成向量,靠向量近邻检索匹配的架构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-tower retrieval encodes query and item with separate towers and matches by vector nearest-neighbor search.

scenario: 面试官问 CLIP 为什么能做零样本分类,不用为新类别微调。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why CLIP can do zero-shot classification without fine-tuning for new classes.
q: CLIP 靠什么实现零样本分类?
q_en: How does CLIP achieve zero-shot classification?
why: 对比学习把配对的图文拉近、不配对的推远,使图像和文本落进同一 embedding 空间且可比。分类时把待测图片 embedding 和各个类别文字描述的 embedding 算 cosine 相似度,取最高者,无需为新类别微调。
why_en: Contrastive training puts images and text in one comparable space, so zero-shot classification just compares an image embedding against text-label embeddings by cosine similarity.
options: 它为每个可能类别预训练了一个分类头,推理时选激活最高的头
它把图片 embedding 和各类别文字描述 embedding 算 cosine,取最高,无需为新类微调
它逐词生成类别名称,像 GPT 一样输出文本标签
它靠海量人工标注覆盖所有类别,本质是有监督分类不是零样本
options_en: It pretrains a classification head per possible class and picks the most activated head.
It computes cosine similarity between the image embedding and each class's text-description embedding, taking the max, no fine-tuning for new classes.
It generates the class name token by token like GPT, outputting a text label.
It relies on massive human labels covering all classes, so it's really supervised, not zero-shot.
optionExplanations: CLIP 没有固定类别的分类头,加新类别不需要新头,这正是它零样本的原因。
对;共享空间让图文向量可比,新类别只要写一句文字描述编码成向量即可参与比较。
生成类别名是 decoder 的活,CLIP 是双编码器做 embedding 比对,不生成文本。
零样本恰恰不需要为目标类别标注,靠的是预训练学到的通用图文对齐。
optionExplanations_en: CLIP has no fixed-class head; adding a class needs no new head, which is exactly why it's zero-shot.
Correct — the shared space makes image and text vectors comparable, so a new class just needs a text description encoded into a vector.
Generating class names is a decoder's job; CLIP is dual encoders comparing embeddings, not generating text.
Zero-shot specifically needs no labels for the target classes, relying on general image-text alignment learned in pretraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时拉近正样本对、推远负样本对,让配对的图文在向量空间靠近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contrastive learning pulls matched pairs together and pushes mismatched pairs apart in vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不为目标类别提供训练样本,直接用文字描述即可分类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot classification labels new classes from text descriptions without any training examples for them.

scenario: 要做看图回答问题(VQA)和图片描述,需要图文的联合推理而不仅是检索。
scenario_en: You need visual question answering and captioning, requiring joint image-text reasoning, not just retrieval.
q: Flamingo 是怎么把视觉信息接进 LLM 的?
q_en: How does Flamingo feed visual information into an LLM?
why: 冻结的视觉编码器出特征,经 Perceiver Resampler 把变长视觉 token 压成固定数量,再通过 transformer 块之间的门控交叉注意力注入冻结的 LLM,门控学每层该吸收多少视觉信息。这样能做少样本 VQA/描述,但整条管线要顺序跑完。
why_en: A frozen vision encoder feeds a Perceiver Resampler that compresses visual tokens to a fixed count, injected into a frozen LLM via gated cross-attention layers.
diagram:
flowchart LR V["冻结视觉编码器"] --> P["Perceiver Resampler
压成固定数量视觉 token"] P --> G["门控交叉注意力"] L["冻结 LLM 块"] --> G G --> O["文本输出"]
options: 把图片切 patch 直接当文本 token 拼进 prompt,让 LLM 自己消化
冻结视觉编码器→Perceiver Resampler 压成固定视觉 token→门控交叉注意力注入冻结 LLM
重新训练整个 LLM,让它端到端学会看图,不冻结任何部分
先用 CLIP 把图片转成一句文字描述,再把描述喂给纯文本 LLM
options_en: Slice the image into patches, use them directly as text tokens in the prompt, and let the LLM digest them.
Frozen vision encoder to a Perceiver Resampler compressing to fixed visual tokens to gated cross-attention into a frozen LLM.
Retrain the whole LLM end-to-end to see images, freezing nothing.
Use CLIP to turn the image into a text caption first, then feed the caption to a text-only LLM.
optionExplanations: 直接拼 patch 当文本 token 无法对齐两种模态,也不是 Flamingo 的机制。
对;Resampler 定长压缩+门控交叉注意力注入,是 Flamingo 让冻结 LLM 获得视觉能力的核心。
Flamingo 特意冻结视觉编码器和 LLM,只训练桥接层,不是端到端重训整个 LLM。
先转文字会丢失细粒度视觉信息,且那是 caption→LLM 的两段式,不是 Flamingo 的联合推理。
optionExplanations_en: Stuffing patches as text tokens doesn't align the modalities and isn't Flamingo's mechanism.
Correct — fixed-length resampling plus gated cross-attention injection is how Flamingo gives a frozen LLM vision.
Flamingo deliberately freezes the vision encoder and LLM, training only the bridge, not retraining the whole LLM end-to-end.
Captioning first loses fine-grained visual detail and is a two-stage caption-then-LLM pipeline, not Flamingo's joint reasoning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把冻结视觉编码器接入冻结 LLM 做少样本 VQA/描述的多模态模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Flamingo is a multimodal model that bridges a frozen vision encoder into a frozen LLM for few-shot VQA and captioning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把变长视觉 token 压缩成固定数量 token 的模块,便于注入 LLM。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Perceiver Resampler compresses variable-length visual tokens into a fixed number for injection into the LLM.

termDefinitions.term: gated cross-attention / 门控交叉注意力
termDefinitions.meaning: LLM 块之间插入的交叉注意力层,门控学每层吸收多少视觉信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gated cross-attention inserts cross-attention layers between LLM blocks, with a gate learning how much visual info each layer absorbs.

scenario: 上线一个 Flamingo 式模型做 VQA,发现无法像 CLIP 那样把 embedding 离线算好、线上查表。
scenario_en: Deploying a Flamingo-style VQA model, you find you can't precompute embeddings and look up like CLIP.
q: 为什么 Flamingo 的服务成本比 CLIP 高得多,怎么应对?
q_en: Why is Flamingo's serving cost much higher than CLIP's, and how do you handle it?
why: Flamingo 无法拆成可预算的双塔:每个请求都要顺序跑完视觉编码器→Resampler→带交叉注意力的 LLM,视觉和语言部分算力需求异构,统一批处理效果差、GPU 显存管理复杂。应对是接受它上实时开销、只在真正需要联合推理时用,并在答案里点明这份成本。
why_en: Flamingo can't decompose into precomputable towers, so every request runs the full heterogeneous vision-then-LLM pipeline, making uniform batching ineffective.
options: 因为 Flamingo 参数比 CLIP 少所以更慢,加参数就能变快
因为它每请求跑完整异构管线、无法预算双塔,统一批处理差、显存管理复杂
因为 Flamingo 必须联网调用外部 API,断网就慢,本地部署就没问题
其实 Flamingo 更便宜,和 CLIP 一样可以离线预算 embedding,原文说反了
options_en: Because Flamingo has fewer params than CLIP it's slower; adding params speeds it up.
Because every request runs the full heterogeneous pipeline with no precomputable towers, so uniform batching is weak and memory management is complex.
Because Flamingo must call an external API over the network, so it's slow offline but fine locally.
Actually Flamingo is cheaper and precomputes embeddings like CLIP; the source is wrong.
optionExplanations: 慢不是因为参数少;加参数只会更慢,根因是无法预算+异构管线。
对;不可拆双塔+异构算力让每请求都要全程跑,批处理和显存都难优化,这正是公认的开放难题。
和外部 API 无关,Flamingo 是本地一整条管线,瓶颈在管线本身不在网络。
恰恰相反:CLIP 可预算 embedding,Flamingo 不行,这是两者服务成本的关键差异。
optionExplanations_en: Slowness isn't from fewer params; adding params is slower, and the root cause is no precompute plus a heterogeneous pipeline.
Correct — non-decomposable towers plus heterogeneous compute force full per-request runs, making batching and memory hard, a known open challenge.
It's not about an external API; Flamingo is one local pipeline whose bottleneck is the pipeline itself, not the network.
The opposite: CLIP can precompute embeddings and Flamingo can't, which is the key serving-cost difference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一管线里不同阶段(视觉编码 vs LLM)对算力和显存的需求形态不同,难以统一批处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Heterogeneous compute means different pipeline stages have different resource profiles, making uniform batching hard.

scenario: 面试官要你用一句话说清 CLIP 和 Flamingo 在服务模式上的本质差异。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to state CLIP vs Flamingo's essential difference in serving pattern.
q: CLIP 和 Flamingo 的服务模式差在哪?
q_en: How do CLIP and Flamingo differ in serving pattern?
why: CLIP 是双塔:两模态 embedding 可离线预算+ANN 查表,推理挪出实时路径;Flamingo 是单条不可拆的管线,每请求顺序跑视觉→Resampler→LLM,只能实时全程算。前者服务便宜可扩,后者贵但能联合推理。
why_en: CLIP is two-tower with precomputable embeddings and ANN lookup, while Flamingo is one non-decomposable pipeline run in full per request.
options: CLIP 每请求全跑管线,Flamingo 可离线预算 embedding,两者角色相反
两者都能预算 embedding,服务成本一样,只是能力不同
CLIP 可预算双塔+ANN 查表(便宜);Flamingo 单管线每请求全跑(贵但能联合推理)
Flamingo 更便宜因为它冻结了大部分参数,而 CLIP 要全量微调所以贵
options_en: CLIP runs the full pipeline per request while Flamingo precomputes embeddings — the roles are reversed.
Both can precompute embeddings and cost the same to serve; only the capability differs.
CLIP precomputes two towers with ANN lookup (cheap); Flamingo runs one pipeline per request (costly but does joint reasoning).
Flamingo is cheaper because it freezes most params, while CLIP needs full fine-tuning so it's costly.
optionExplanations: 角色说反了:可预算 embedding 的是 CLIP,每请求全跑的是 Flamingo。
服务成本差很大:CLIP 查表 vs Flamingo 全跑,不是一样。
对;可预算双塔 vs 不可拆单管线,是两者服务成本和适用能力的分水岭。
冻结参数不改变"每请求要不要全跑管线"这个成本结构,Flamingo 仍比 CLIP 贵。
optionExplanations_en: The roles are reversed: CLIP is the one that precomputes embeddings and Flamingo runs fully per request.
Serving costs differ a lot: CLIP looks up while Flamingo runs fully — not the same.
Correct — precomputable towers vs a non-decomposable pipeline is the divide in both serving cost and capability.
Freezing params doesn't change whether the full pipeline runs per request, so Flamingo is still costlier than CLIP.

scenario: 产品要"看着这张图回答用户的自然语言问题",答案依赖图文的联合理解,不是找相似图。
scenario_en: The product must answer a user's natural-language question about a specific image, needing joint understanding, not similar-image lookup.
q: 这个跨模态推理任务该选什么,面试里还要补一句什么?
q_en: Which architecture for this cross-modal reasoning task, and what caveat do you add?
why: 选 Flamingo 类联合推理架构,因为 VQA 要模型同时理解图和问题再生成答案,CLIP 的向量比对只能做检索不能推理。面试里要主动补一句服务代价:无法预算双塔、每请求全跑异构管线、延迟和 GPU 显存都更高。
why_en: Pick a Flamingo-style joint-reasoning model because VQA needs the model to reason over image and question together, and explicitly flag its serving cost.
options: CLIP,把问题和图片各编码成向量算相似度就能回答问题
Flamingo 类联合推理,并主动点明它无法预算双塔、每请求全跑、服务成本高
纯文本 LLM,忽略图片直接凭问题猜答案
MobileNet,先分类图片再拼一句模板答案
options_en: CLIP — encode question and image to vectors and score similarity to answer the question.
A Flamingo-style joint-reasoning model, explicitly flagging that it can't precompute towers, runs fully per request, and costs more to serve.
A text-only LLM — ignore the image and guess from the question.
MobileNet — classify the image then fill a template answer.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务其实只是"找与这段文字/这张图最相似的图",那 CLIP 的双塔检索又便宜又够用,不必上 Flamingo。
optionExplanations: cosine 相似度只能判"像不像",答不了"图里发生了什么、为什么"这类推理问题。
对;VQA 需要联合推理选 Flamingo,并按面试要求同口气说清它的服务代价,才是完整答法。
忽略图片就答非所问,VQA 的答案本质依赖图像内容。
先分类再套模板无法处理开放式问题,丢掉了问题与图像的联合语义。
optionExplanations_en: Cosine similarity only judges 'how alike', not 'what's happening and why' reasoning questions.
Correct — VQA needs joint reasoning (Flamingo) and, per interview norms, stating its serving cost in the same breath completes the answer.
Ignoring the image misses the point; a VQA answer fundamentally depends on image content.
Classify-then-template can't handle open-ended questions and drops the joint semantics of question and image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给定图片和自然语言问题,模型联合理解后生成答案。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: VQA (Visual Question Answering) has a model jointly understand an image and a natural-language question to produce an answer.

scenario: 用 CLIP 搭以文搜图,要把"双塔可预算"落成一条实际的服务流水线。
scenario_en: Building text-to-image search with CLIP, turn 'precomputable two-tower' into a concrete serving pipeline.
q: 把 CLIP 检索的服务流水线排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the CLIP retrieval serving pipeline correctly:
steps: 在线:用文本编码器把用户查询编码成向量
离线:用 CLIP 图像编码器批量把海量图片编码成向量
把离线图片向量灌进 ANN 索引建好近邻检索结构
在线做 cosine 最近邻查询,返回 top-k 图片
why: 先离线把图片全量编码(最重、可提前算),再建 ANN 索引;线上只把查询编码成向量、做 cosine 近邻查表。重活挪到离线,实时路径只剩一次编码+一次查表,所以能低延迟扛高 QPS。
why_en: Precompute all image vectors offline, build the ANN index, then at serving encode only the query and do a cosine nearest-neighbor lookup, keeping the hot path light.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  O["离线编码图片"] --> B["建 ANN 索引"]
  Q["在线编码查询"] --> C["cosine 查表 top-k"]
  B --> C

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两个向量夹角的余弦衡量方向相似度,CLIP 检索里越大越相关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cosine similarity measures directional closeness of two vectors; higher means more relevant in CLIP retrieval.

scenario: 任务是开放式文本生成(写摘要草稿、续写),需要逐词自回归产出,不是分类或检索。
scenario_en: The task is open-ended text generation (draft summaries, continuations), needing autoregressive output, not classification or retrieval.
q: 该选哪种 transformer,并在架构图上标注什么?
q_en: Which transformer, and what do you annotate on the diagram?
why: 选 decoder-only:自回归生成正是它的形态。图上要标注显存带宽约束和预期 tokens/秒,因为生成成本由权重搬运主导、长输出要按 tok/s 估延迟,标清这两点才说明你懂它的服务瓶颈。
why_en: Pick decoder-only for autoregressive generation and annotate the memory-bandwidth constraint plus expected tokens/sec, since those govern its serving cost.
options: encoder-only(BERT),生成任务也能靠双向 embedding 一次出全文
decoder-only,标注显存带宽约束 + 预期 tokens/秒
CLIP,把文本生成当跨模态检索来做
MobileNet,轻量所以生成也快
options_en: Encoder-only (BERT) — generation can also come from bidirectional embeddings in one shot.
Decoder-only, annotating the memory-bandwidth constraint plus expected tokens/sec.
CLIP — treat text generation as cross-modal retrieval.
MobileNet — lightweight, so generation is fast too.
whenOtherWins: 如果其实不需要自由生成、只要从固定候选里选(分类/检索),那 encoder-only 更快更省,不必用 decoder。
optionExplanations: encoder-only 不做自回归生成,它出的是理解用的 embedding,一次出全文不是它的能力。
对;decoder-only 是生成形态,标注带宽瓶颈和 tok/s 说明你会估它的延迟和服务成本。
CLIP 是图文检索模型,和文本生成不是一回事,套不上。
MobileNet 是视觉 CNN,与文本生成无关,轻量也生成不了文本。
optionExplanations_en: Encoder-only doesn't do autoregressive generation; it yields understanding embeddings, not full-text output in one shot.
Correct — decoder-only is the generation form, and annotating the bandwidth bottleneck and tokens/sec shows you can estimate its serving cost.
CLIP is an image-text retrieval model, unrelated to text generation.
MobileNet is a vision CNN, irrelevant to text generation; being lightweight can't generate text.

scenario: 评审说两个候选人都选了 ResNet-50,一个只报了名字,另一个多说了几句,后者评分更高。
scenario_en: Two candidates both chose ResNet-50; one just named it, the other added a few words and scored higher.
q: 架构答案里加什么能把强答案和平庸答案区分开?
q_en: What separates a strong architecture answer from a mediocre one?
why: 在架构图上标三样东西:大致延迟、参数量、离线/在线边界(哪步能预算缓存)。显式说出取舍——为什么这个约束下选它、代价是什么——才是强答案;只报模型名说明你没把选择和约束绑起来。
why_en: Annotate the diagram with approximate latency, parameter count, and the offline/online boundary, and state the trade-off explicitly rather than just naming a model.
options: 多背几个模型名和发表年份,显得知识面广
在图上标大致延迟、参数量、离线/在线边界,并显式说出取舍
强调自己用过最新最大的模型,越大越显水平
只报模型名但语气更自信,评审就会给高分
options_en: Recite more model names and publication years to look broad.
Annotate the diagram with approximate latency, parameter count, and the offline/online boundary, and state the trade-off explicitly.
Emphasize using the newest, largest model — bigger looks more capable.
Just name the model but sound more confident, and reviewers score higher.
optionExplanations: 背名字和年份是知识展示,不等于会做工程取舍,评审看的是后者。
对;把延迟/参数/离线在线边界标出来并说清代价,证明你是被约束推着选,这才是高信号。
越大越好是误区,忽略延迟和显存约束的"大模型崇拜"恰恰是弱答案。
自信补不上缺失的取舍分析,评审要的是你把选择和约束绑起来的推理。
optionExplanations_en: Reciting names and years is knowledge display, not engineering trade-off skill, which is what reviewers grade.
Correct — annotating latency/params/offline-online and stating the cost proves the constraints drove your choice, the high-signal move.
Bigger-is-better is a trap; ignoring latency and memory constraints is exactly the weak answer.
Confidence can't replace missing trade-off analysis; reviewers want the reasoning tying choice to constraints.

scenario: 任务是摘要和翻译这类输入是序列、输出也是序列的 seq2seq。
scenario_en: The task is summarization and translation — seq2seq where both input and output are sequences.
q: encoder-decoder(T5)的服务成本为什么是最高的一档?
q_en: Why is encoder-decoder (T5)'s serving cost in the highest tier?
why: 它把两份成本叠在一起:先用 encoder 一次前向编码整段输入(编码成本),再用 decoder 逐词自回归解码输出(生成成本,受显存带宽约束)。所以摘要/翻译这类 seq2seq 天生比纯分类或纯检索贵。
why_en: Encoder-decoder stacks both costs: a full encode of the input plus autoregressive decoding of the output, so seq2seq is inherently pricier than pure classification or retrieval.
options: 因为它参数一定比 GPT 多,纯粹是模型更大导致慢
因为它把编码成本和逐词自回归解码成本叠在一起
因为它必须实时联网翻译,网络往返是主要开销
其实它最便宜,编码和解码可以完全并行没有额外成本
options_en: Because it always has more params than GPT; it's simply a bigger model.
Because it stacks the encoding cost and the token-by-token autoregressive decoding cost.
Because it must translate over the network in real time, and round-trips dominate cost.
Actually it's cheapest — encode and decode fully parallelize with no extra cost.
optionExplanations: 不是参数量的锅,同参数下它也更贵,根因是两段成本叠加。
对;encode 一次+decode 逐词,两份成本相加,这是 seq2seq 形态的固有代价。
和联网无关,成本在本地的编码+自回归解码两段计算上。
解码是自回归的,必须逐词串行,无法和编码完全并行掉成本。
optionExplanations_en: It's not about param count; even at equal params it's costlier, because two cost stages stack.
Correct — one encode plus token-by-token decode sums both costs, the inherent price of the seq2seq form.
Not about networking; the cost is local encode plus autoregressive decode.
Decoding is autoregressive and serial by token, so it can't fully parallelize away the cost against encoding.
